name: Voltaris
description: AI PCB design for KiCad 10 with Claude: schematic, layout, ERC/DRC, design-rule checks, datasheets, simulation, manufacturing files and firmware bring-up.
description_full: Voltaris connects Claude to KiCad 10 on your computer. Describe a board and Claude researches parts, draws the schematic, places and routes the PCB, checks it with ERC, DRC, your own plain-English rules and datasheet requirements, and exports Gerbers, BOM and placement files for JLCPCB and other fabs. It includes engineering calculators (trace width, impedance, vias, regulator thermals), a verified circuit library, circuit simulation, signal-integrity checks, LCSC part import, snapshots and diffs, block diagrams, a 3D-printable enclosure generator, and firmware pin maps for ESP32, RP2040/RP2350, STM32 and nRF52. Works with your Claude plan; runs locally.
